name: drone-dark
description: Drone gelap ~7 dtk — suspense, misteri, latar tegang

name: rain-ambience
description: Ambience hujan 8 dtk, fade in/out (dibuat FFmpeg)

name: glitch-1
description: Punchy digital glitch — hard-cut accent or sudden reveal. Trigger on the hit; let the decay bleed into the next shot (J-cut).

name: glitch-2
description: Harsh, longer glitch — chaotic / jarring transition or a distorted reveal.

name: glitch-3
description: Low-key glitch texture — subtle digital shift, minimal transition that sits under other audio.

name: boom-cinematic
description: Boom sinematik — judul besar, reveal dramatis

name: drum-hit
description: Pukulan drum — beat aksen, teks slam

name: glass-break
description: Kaca pecah — gagal, mitos dipatahkan, shock

name: hit-boom
description: Hit/boom rendah 1.8 dtk (dibuat FFmpeg)

name: impact-bass-1
description: Bass impact hit — logo/hero snap, headline slam. Trigger on the visual landing; decay carries into the next shot (J-cut).

name: impact-bass-2
description: Bass impact with a short swell — brief anticipation then a deep hit. Place so the peak lands on the reveal.

name: punch
description: Pukulan/tinju — aksi, benturan cepat

name: riser
description: Long cinematic riser (~10s build, peak at the end). Trigger at (climax_time − 10.03s) so it crests exactly on the reveal.

name: riser-short
description: Riser pendek ~3 dtk — build-up singkat sebelum reveal

name: thud-slam
description: Thud bass berat — objek jatuh, banting

name: bird-chirp
description: Satu kicau burung — pagi, alam, suasana ceria

name: fire-crackle
description: Api berderak — api, panas, kemah

name: rain-drops
description: Rintik hujan besar ~10 dtk — loop latar hujan

name: splash
description: Cipratan air — sesuatu jatuh ke air

name: thunder
description: Gemuruh petir — badai, momen dramatis

name: water-drop
description: Satu tetes air — air, hujan mulai, ide muncul

name: wave-splash
description: Ombak besar pecah — laut, pantai

name: wind-gust
description: Hembusan angin ~8 dtk — cuaca, perpindahan, sepi

name: applause
description: Tepuk tangan ~6 dtk — akhir presentasi, apresiasi

name: crowd-cheer
description: Kerumunan kecil bersorak + tepuk tangan — menang, perayaan

name: footsteps
description: Langkah kaki di lantai keras — berjalan, datang

name: heartbeat
description: Satu detak jantung — tegang, kesehatan, emosi

name: page-turn
description: Balik halaman kertas — ganti bab, slide dokumen

name: swipe
description: Swipe halus — ganti scene / kartu geser

name: swoosh-fast
description: Swoosh sangat pendek (tongkat membelah udara) — gerakan cepat, slide in

name: whoosh
description: Punchy whoosh/impact — fast reveal or hard transition accent. Sync to the motion.

name: whoosh-cinematic
description: Cinematic whoosh build (~5.5s) — sweeping scene transition. Align so the swell peaks on the cut.

name: whoosh-low
description: Whoosh rendah dan berat — transisi besar, objek besar lewat

name: whoosh-reverse
description: Whoosh terbalik (naik ke titik) — sebelum reveal/cut

name: whoosh-short
description: Short whoosh — quick swipe/slide accent, fast element move, snappy transition. Sync to the motion.

name: whoosh-soft
description: Whoosh lembut 0.9 dtk (dibuat FFmpeg)

name: bell-ding
description: Ding bel — notifikasi, poin penting, jawaban benar

name: camera-shutter
description: Jepretan kamera — screenshot, foto muncul, freeze frame

name: cash-register
description: Mesin kasir 'ka-ching' — harga, penjualan, uang

name: chime
description: Soft melodic chime — gentle positive beat: success/confirmation or a lighthearted transition. Sync to the visual moment.

name: chime-gleam
description: Chime berkilau — highlight, magic, produk bersinar

name: click
description: Crisp UI click — button press, toggle, selection. Short accent, sync exactly to the on-screen action.

name: click-soft
description: Quiet short click — low-key UI tap / soft selection. Short accent, sync exactly to the on-screen action.

name: clock-ticking
description: Jam berdetak — waktu, deadline, countdown

name: coin
description: Koin game — poin, reward, bonus

name: counter-ticks
description: Tik-tik counter — angka naik, statistik berjalan

name: error
description: Negative / error tone — failure state, a 'wrong' beat, or a glitchy interruption.

name: key-press
description: Single key press — one keystroke / terminal-input beat. Short accent, sync to the typed character.

name: laser
description: Laser sci-fi — efek tech, scan, garis muncul

name: notification
description: Notification chime — alert, message-in, toast/badge appears. Sync to the element entering.

name: ping
description: Sharp electronic ping — punchy accent on a key reveal or data point. Sync to the beat.

name: pop
description: Quick pop — element appear/spawn, chip/tag/badge in. Small precise accent, sync to the pop-in.

name: pop-bubble
description: Pop gelembung kecil — elemen muncul, ikon spawn

name: record-scratch
description: Scratch piringan — stop mendadak, 'tunggu dulu', plot twist

name: sparkle
description: Bright sparkle / shimmer — magical reveal or 'shine' highlight on a hero element. Sync to the highlight.

name: success
description: Jingle sukses — selesai, centang, pencapaian

name: typewriter-bell
description: Bel mesin tik — akhir baris teks, judul selesai diketik

name: typing
description: Typing burst (~1.5s of keys) — keyboard / code typing reveal, text-being-typed beat. Start as the text begins typing.
